title: MindWave Project Journey file
description: A Journey FILE is an array of Journey objects. Per-type step requirements (move needs 'to'; act needs 'action' + 'target'; checkpoint needs 'label') are enforced by tools/validate_project_map.py, which also checks actions against the Map vocabulary.

journey.description: steps is required for plain journeys; matrix journeys may omit it (the matrix defines the steps). tools/validate_project_map.py enforces this semantically.

matrix.description: Data-driven expansion (Phase 7.3): the journey expands into one probe journey per (role, target) pair before execution. Expansion output is a Journey — never a Map edit.

action.description: Action to probe with; defaults to 'view' under the effective vocabulary.

set.description: State keys to set when this step executes; mutations live in the Trace, never the Map (Phase 7.5).
